force_resolution_principles: §11.5 When governed representation cannot establish force, force remains UNRESOLVED. No default force is inferred.
§11.6 A P3 representation gap does not by itself suppress the final EI Direction.
§11.7 Unresolved evidence is omitted from transition contribution while remaining visible in evidence-level audit trace.

no_effect_is_not_unresolved.NO_EFFECT: the governed information establishes that this phenomenon makes no EI transition. Outcome label NOT_ADMITTED.
no_effect_is_not_unresolved.UNRESOLVED_REPRESENTATION_GAP: there is not enough information to judge the force at all. It was not used in this transition, and it is ⛔ NOT a finding of NO EFFECT. Outcome label UNRESOLVED with a root cause and gap id.
no_effect_is_not_unresolved.rule: the two states are never merged and never share a rule id.

score_continuity_principle.statement: A P3 input-representation gap does not by itself invalidate an otherwise runnable EI scoring unit. The unresolved P3 evidence contributes no state transition but remains explicitly unresolved in the audit trace. Final EI Direction is calculated from the valid Base and all remaining resolved evidence. Unresolved evidence is never relabeled NO EFFECT.
score_continuity_principle.scope: ONLY the D03A/D03B representation-gap rule GFR-S-FM4-V126-U1.

score_continuity_principle.scoping_note: ⛔ scoped by RULE ID, not by gap token — GAP-08 is shared vocabulary and gap-id scoping would have silently changed the Exotic-Skin fail-closed row.
